ITBP CAPF Medical Officer Online Form 2026 – Last Date - Complete Details

Short Information : Indo Tibetan Border Police Force (ITBP) has released the notification for the post of Medical Officer. This recruitment has been issued for 282 posts. Candidates must check the complete details for ITBP CAPF Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 August 2026
  • Last Date : 08 September 2026

Application Fee

  • SC, ST & All Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
